name: Fountain pen [万年筆]
definition: pen that feeds liquid ink from a reservoir to a split nib; filling system, nib size, shape and material and body material are attributes.

name: Dip pen (nib holder and nibs)
definition: holder with loose nibs dipped in a separate bottle of ink; a dip pen or nib whose maker names comics or drawing only is C4.

name: Ballpoint pen [ボールペン]
definition: pen that rolls viscous oil-based ink onto paper through a ball tip; a digital pen that writes in ink and records it carries `recording`.

name: Gel pen
definition: ball-tip pen with water-based gel ink.

name: Rollerball pen
definition: ball-tip pen with liquid water-based ink; a recording digital pen of this type carries `recording`.

name: Multi pen
definition: one barrel holding several ball or gel refills (and sometimes a pencil) selected in turn.

name: Felt-tip pen (fineliner)
definition: fine fibre-tip pen made for writing, or for writing and drawing both.

name: Marker pen
definition: broad fibre or felt-tip pen for marking and labelling.

name: Highlighter [蛍光ペン]
definition: broad-tip pen with translucent fluorescent ink for marking text.

name: Brush pen
definition: pen with a flexible brush tip whose maker names handwriting, lettering or calligraphy first or both (a fudepen is here); drawing-only brush pens are C4.

name: Calligraphy brush (shodo brush)
definition: hair brush made for East Asian calligraphy.

name: Ink stick
definition: solid stick of soot and binder ground on an inkstone to make calligraphy ink.

name: Inkstone
definition: stone slab with a well on which an ink stick is ground with water.

name: Calligraphy set
definition: brush, ink and inkstone sold and compared as one kit (S3a).

name: Wooden pencil (wood-cased)
definition: graphite core cased in wood, sharpened to use.

name: Mechanical pencil [シャープペンシル]
definition: refillable holder that advances a thin lead by a mechanism.

name: Eraser
definition: block of rubber or plastic that rubs out pencil or ink marks.

name: Correction tape
definition: dispenser that lays a dry white film over a written mark.

name: Correction fluid
definition: quick-drying white liquid brushed or penned over a written mark.

name: Pencil sharpener
definition: device that sharpens a wooden pencil; `drive` (manual, electric) is an attribute of the one kind.

name: Notebook
definition: bound book of blank, lined, dot or graph sheets for notes ("journal" is an alias); size, ruling, binding, paper stock and `reusable` are attributes.

name: Composition book
definition: sewn notebook with a stiff marbled-style board cover and lined pages.

name: Refillable notebook system
definition: cover plus refill books sold together as one system (TRAVELER'S notebook is a named form); covers and refills sold separately are C5.5.5.

name: Diary / planner [手帳, techo]
definition: bound book ruled by date or for dates (daily, weekly, monthly), dated or undated; Hobonichi Techo is a named form.

name: Calendar
definition: printed sheets of the days, weeks or months of a year; `format` (wall, desk, pocket) is an attribute.

name: Sticky-note calendar [ひめくり, himekuri]
definition: tear-off or sticky-note day calendar, one sheet per day (level provisional, C11).

name: Loose-leaf paper
definition: punched loose sheets made for a binder.

name: Memo pad
definition: glued or bound pad of tear-off sheets for short notes.

name: Sticky notes
definition: pad of small sheets with a repositionable adhesive strip ("adhesive notes" in Australia).

name: Letter-writing paper set
definition: writing sheets sold with matching envelopes for letters ("letter set").

name: Copy and printer paper
definition: plain cut sheets sold by the ream for copiers and printers (K-158; photographic paper is D4).

name: Envelope
definition: folded paper cover for posting a letter or document (K-193).

name: Padded envelope
definition: envelope lined with bubble or paper padding for posting small items (K-193).

name: Mailing tube
definition: rigid tube for posting rolled documents (K-193).

name: Greeting card
definition: folded printed card with envelope, sold blank inside or with a message, to be written and sent.

name: Gift wrap
definition: printed or decorated paper sold for wrapping presents.

name: Sticker sheet
definition: sheet of printed self-adhesive stickers sold as stationery (a collectible sticker series is F3).

name: Pen cup
definition: open pot that stands pens and pencils upright on a desk.

name: Pencil case
definition: pouch, box or roll that holds several pens and pencils (K-132; a one-pen sleeve is C5.5.4.01).

name: Document tray (letter tray)
definition: flat open tray, often stackable, that holds papers on a desk.

name: Magazine holder (desktop magazine file)
definition: upright open-sided box that holds magazines or files on a desk or shelf.

name: Desk pad / blotter
definition: large mat or blotting pad laid on the desk top to write on.

name: Noticeboard
definition: cork or fabric board to which notices are pinned.

name: Whiteboard
definition: smooth board written on with dry-erase markers.

name: Stapler [ホチキス]
definition: device that drives a wire staple through sheets to join them; `drive` is an attribute.

name: Hole punch
definition: device that cuts filing holes in sheets.

name: Paper trimmer
definition: guillotine or rotary cutter that trims sheets straight.

name: Scissors (household and office)
definition: general-purpose scissors for paper and household use (K-171).

name: Rubber stamp (office)
definition: hand stamp with a rubber die for dates, words or marks on office papers (decorative stamps are C4).

name: Stamp ink pad (office)
definition: inked pad for office stamps (ink pads for decorative stamps are C4).

name: Name seal [印鑑, hanko]
definition: personal seal stamped as a signature (region Japan; level provisional, C11).

name: Paper clip
definition: bent wire loop that clips sheets together.

name: Bulldog clip
definition: sprung metal clip that grips a thick stack of sheets.

name: Drawing pin
definition: short pin with a flat head pressed into a board to hold paper.

name: Glue stick
definition: solid glue in a twist-up tube for sticking paper (K-171).

name: Desk tape (sticky tape)
definition: narrow transparent adhesive tape for paper and desk use (K-171).

name: Tape dispenser
definition: weighted holder with a cutting edge for desk tape.

name: Ring binder
definition: stiff cover with a ring mechanism that holds punched sheets.

name: Lever arch file
definition: binder with a lever-operated two-ring arch mechanism for large volumes of sheets.

name: Box file
definition: lidded box-shaped file with a spring clip that holds loose papers.

name: Ruler
definition: straight strip with a graduated scale for measuring and ruling lines.

name: Geometry set (compasses, protractor)
definition: case of drawing compass, protractor, set squares and ruler sold as one set.

name: Drawing compass
definition: two-legged instrument that draws circles and arcs (a navigation compass is E2).

name: Postal scale
definition: small scale for weighing letters and parcels for postage (K-167).

name: Basic desktop calculator
definition: calculator for the four operations and percentages, with a display.

name: Printing calculator
definition: desktop calculator that prints its figures on a paper roll.

name: Scientific calculator
definition: calculator with trigonometric, logarithmic and statistical functions.

name: Graphing calculator
definition: programmable calculator that plots functions on a graphic display.

name: Financial calculator
definition: calculator with time-value-of-money and other finance functions.

name: Abacus [そろばん, soroban]
definition: frame of beads on rods moved by hand to calculate (soroban is a non-maker named form).

name: Slide rule
definition: pair of sliding logarithmic scales for multiplying and dividing (C-17).

name: Shredder
definition: machine that cuts paper into strips or particles; cut type is an attribute.

name: Laminator
definition: machine that seals a sheet between plastic films by heat or pressure.

name: Binding machine
definition: machine that punches and binds sheets with combs, wires or covers.

name: Label maker (label printer of any connection)
definition: device that prints adhesive labels on tape; `connection` (standalone, computer, phone) is an attribute (K-158).

name: Typewriter
definition: machine that prints characters on paper as keys are struck; `drive` (manual, electric) is an attribute.

name: Bottled fountain-pen ink
definition: bottled ink made for fountain pens; dye or pigment, wetness, saturation, shading, sheen, water resistance and colour are attributes.

name: Ink cartridge
definition: sealed ink cartridge that fits a fountain pen's cartridge standard.

name: Converter
definition: refillable piston or squeeze reservoir that fits in place of a cartridge.

name: Replacement nib
definition: nib or nib unit sold to fit a fountain pen.

name: Pen refill
definition: ink refill made to fit a ballpoint, gel, rollerball or multi pen.

name: Pencil lead refill
definition: tube of leads made for mechanical pencils; grade and diameter are attributes.

name: Single-pen sleeve
definition: sleeve or case that holds one pen (K-132).

name: Planner or notebook cover
definition: cover made for one planner or notebook system, sold separately.

name: Refill notebook
definition: refill book made for one cover or notebook system.

name: Index tabs (for a planner system)
definition: tabs made to fit one planner system.

name: Staple
definition: wire staples in strips made to fit a stapler.

name: Label tape cassette
definition: tape cartridge made to fit one label-maker system (Brother TZe, DYMO D1, DYMO LetraTag and Epson LK are C13 cartridge-standard rows; provisional until attested).
